Mission Local reported that the State Bar required San Francisco District Attorney Brooke Jenkins to participate in an ethics diversion program after complaints concerning her access to and sharing of a confidential rap sheet. The article called the decision ironic, noting that Jenkins had moved away from diversion programs promoted by her predecessor, Chesa Boudin. It also quoted a State Bar spokesperson describing diversion as a way to provide education, direction and warning.
